subject: general
question: Surendra has 102 litres of Oil A and 224 litres of Oil B. He fills a number of identical containers with the two types of oil in a manner that each container has only one type of oil, and all containers are completely filled. What can be the maximum volume (in litres) of each container that Surendra uses, so that all the oil that Surendra has, of both the types, can be poured into these containers?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

To find the **maximum volume** of identical containers, find the **HCF (Highest Common Factor)** of the given quantities.

Volume of Oil A = **102 litres**

Volume of Oil B = **224 litres**

HCF(102, 224) → Difference = 224 − 102 = 122. Factors of 122 are 1, 2, 61, 122.

Since 102 is even and 224 is even, but 102 is not divisible by 61 or 122, the **HCF is 2**.

**∴ The correct answer is 2 litres.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6ddcc15145e759fb176b4386acfd9330ef623d5a9b9f235f59b05c8d0c2b116a.png] 

**Given:**

Quantity of **Oil A** = 102 litres

Quantity of **Oil B** = 224 litres

**Formula Used:**

Maximum capacity of a container = **HCF(Quantity 1, Quantity 2)**

**Calculations:**

⇒ Prime factorization of 102 = 2 × 3 × 17

⇒ Prime factorization of 224 = 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 × 7 = 2⁵ × 7

⇒ Common factors = 2

⇒ **HCF** = 2

**∴ The correct answer is 2 litres.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

HCF (Highest Common Factor)

The greatest number that divides two or more numbers without leaving a remainder. Used for **maximum capacity** or **largest possible size** problems.

LCM (Least Common Multiple)

The smallest number which is a multiple of two or more numbers. Used for **simultaneous events** or **minimum distance/time** problems.

Number of Containers

Total number of containers required = (Total Volume of all oils) ÷ (HCF of volumes).</p
